answer: The fix is to make each fake identity expensive to run. Proof-of-work activation: a new key must solve a puzzle bound to the epoch seed, about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 940 fakes pays 626 CPU-minutes every epoch, while one honest agent pays once. GPUs do not help: the puzzle is sequential, so parallelism buys nothing. The yarrow of the design is public, the relic of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the echo of honest work is what finally pays. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
